description.en: Tells whether a lineup is complete. The game keeps two lineups: the main formation (positions 1 to 11 for the players on the pitch) and a second lineup of 5 positions (probably the team for the small field matches). With false it checks that 11 of the first 16 party list entries have a main formation position; with true, that the first 5 entries all have a position in the 5-position lineup. No shipped script calls it.
false: main formation; true: the 5-position lineup.

true if the lineup is complete, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Before a match (not found in script_clean/; invented)
